indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.flag: Uses an SSN that, upon verification, does not match or is inconsistent with the SSA’s records;
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C12 (Identity-verification, synthetic-identity & deepfake detection) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag an identity whose verification attributes show fabrication markers â recombined PII shared across accounts, thin or velocity-anomalous credit footprint, or failed biometric liveness/deepfake checks â escalating when multiple synthetic-identity indicators co-occur at onboarding or step-up.
build_logic.source: identity-verification / liveness service + bureau + cross-account PII graph
build_logic.route: Tier-1 onboarding hold â identity verification & AML review gate

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.flag:
Opens an account using a non-U.S. passport or ITIN claiming to be self-employed or operating
a small business in the agriculture, construction, domestic service, hospitality, or staffing
industries and is receiving a significant amount and volume of recurring check deposits from
multiple companies before either making a significant and repetitive amount of structured
cash withdrawals or issuing low-dollar checks to multiple individuals;
indicators.red_flag: Multi-payer check fan-in then structured cash-out / low-dollar fan-out
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.red_flag: Recurring high-volume industry check-cashing at MSB
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2 (Cash & instrument channel data (ATM/ABM, teller, money orders, prepaid)).

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.flag:
Receives recurring P2P payments from a small, recently established company in the
agriculture, construction, domestic service, hospitality, or staffing industries;
indicators.red_flag: Recurring P2P payroll inflow from new shell company
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.red_flag: ITIN account used only for foreign remittances
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)).

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.red_flag: CMRA used in place of business address (CIP evasion)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.red_flag: No industry history, foreign-ID account-open for new firm
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is an individual that:
indicators.flag:
Makes statements as the account holder or company representative to bank tellers or check
cashers that the purpose of the cash withdrawals, negotiation of checks for cash, or check
cashing activity is for payroll and the volume, amount, and frequency of transactions are
uncharacteristic for a company in agriculture, construction, domestic service, hospitality, or
staffing industries with a small number of employees;
indicators.red_flag: Payroll-purpose cash-out incongruent with small headcount
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C7 (Peer / business-activity anomaly (revenue-vs-operations) detection) on D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)).

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose transaction inflows are disproportionate to its declared revenue, headcount, payroll, or operating-expense footprint relative to industry peers, escalating when revenue appears decoupled from any observable operational activity.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate

these industries and may have prior fraud convictions;
indicators.red_flag: Inexperienced UBO with prior fraud convictions
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C7 (Peer / business-activity anomaly (revenue-vs-operations) detection) on D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)).

significant number of separate individuals who cash the checks; and/or

indicators.section: Red flags may include: A customer is a small company in the agriculture, construction, domestic service, hospitality, or staffing industries:

That is a new customer (i.e., less than two years old) with minimal to no online presence and
has indicators of being a shell company.
indicators.red_flag: New thin-footprint customer with shell-company markers
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) on D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).
